newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telepar still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telepar still a buy.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio/Salomon Brothers Inc said in a statement it maintains its buy recommendation on Parana state telecom company Telepar.

-- It said Telepar's third-quarter results of $35.6 million, giving the company a nine-month accumulated result of $103.5 million, were better than Patrimonio's current year-end estimate of $115 million.
-- The company would continue to accelerate expansion of its cellular network in the last quarter, adding 25,000 new cellular lines to its existing 797,000 lines in September, it said.
-- It also said Telepar preferred is currently traded at 3.9 times FV/EBITDA and its value per total lines, including conventional and cellular, is $1,540.
-- These indicators continue to reflect an attractive valuation compared with other major Brazilian telecom stocks, the bank said.
